label: Kamerad
description:
Control your action camera (e.g. GoPro Hero) from your Karoo.

GoPro and HERO are trademarks of GoPro, Inc. Kamerad is not affiliated with or endorsed by GoPro or Hammerhead.
releaseNotes: The event log now records why the camera connection was lost and how strong the signal was, to help find the cause of dropouts. The About screen has a disclaimer, and the website explains that GoPro Quik on your phone can block the camera while Kamerad uses it.
